title: Ticking Create & Edit on Work order lines also ticks Work orders View
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role).
custom_steps:
1. Tick Create & Edit on Work order lines.
  2. Look at the Work orders card.
evidence: UI: ticking Work order lines Create & Edit on blank form opens dialog "Enable Work Orders: View? — Work Order Lines requires Work Orders: View. Enable it to grant this permission?" [Cancel|Enable]; Enable -> WO View ON + WOL C&E ON.
